ways.label: Black Hill Walk

via.name: highway
via.quote: follows it back to Lodge Road

evidence:
The track descends steeply to the
highway and follows it back to Lodge Road.
Getting there: The walk starts at the end of Lodge Road in St Arnaud.

ways.label: Moraine Walk

start.name: junction of SH 63 and Lodge Road
start.quote: junction of SH 63 and Lodge Road

evidence: The walk passes through the back of West Bay campground and on to the Buller River.
Getting there: Start the walk at the junction of SH 63 and Lodge Road in St Arnaud.

ways.label: Anglers Walk

start.name: Buller Bridge on Mt Robert Road
start.quote: Buller Bridge on Mt Robert Road

evidence: Getting there: Start at the Buller Bridge on Mt Robert Road near St Arnaud, just below the river’s lake source.
This walk makes a pleasant extension to Moraine Walk and the circuit can be completed by returning along SH 63.

doubts: Page covers three separate walks (network). Which Lodge Road end feature (F2/F4) and highway junction feature (F1/F3) are meant is not clear, so refs are null. Anglers Walk end and shape not stated; only that it extends Moraine Walk and a circuit can be completed along SH 63.
